Let’s talk about love languages

January 12, 2026

This page may have affiliate links and/or sponsored content.

Some time ago, I read a book titled “The 5 Love Languages.”

Long story short, we all feel love differently. Some like to be told they’re loved, some like gifts, some like touch, and some like quality time.

If you’ve been feeling frustrated in your relationship lately, maybe now’s a good time for a sit-down love-language talk.

Him: So, what’s your love language?

Me: Touch. Tight hugs every morning and evening.

Him: Gladly.

Me: Cool. What’s yours?

Him: Affirmation. Five “I love yous” a day?

Me: Deal.

In marketing, it’s the same. People buy differently. Some respond to trust, some to urgency, some to words.

At the core of both love and marketing is trust.

Show up regularly. Use words carefully. Build relationships first.
